title: Natural hedges and bushes, real tree trunks and a proper park bench
caption: Trees, bushes, hedges and benches outdoors are now Blender models. Trunks taper, flare at the roots and fork into limbs. Hedges and bushes are leafy clumps with no repeating leaf grid, and benches have timber slats on cast-iron ends. This is in every outdoor place, in both the default and the street style. Paths, kerbs, steps and beds are a separate job.
